summary: Get the current user’s OIDC link
description: Requires a full authenticated NPM user session. Always refers to the bearer-token owner.

issuer.description: Linked issuer or an empty string.

available.description: A valid provider configuration is saved and enabled.

can_unlink.description: Whether a non-deleted local password record with a nonempty secret exists; independent of linked.

400.description: Session is unavailable or lacks user access.
